mapper.select: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, r.id AS revision_id, m.kind, v.id AS declaration_id, '' AS upload_state, link.scope_type, link.scope_key, r.state, (link.scope_type = 'CONVERSATION') AS conversation_scoped, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk c WHERE c.revision_id = r.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.modality IN ('TEXT', 'TABLE')) AS has_text, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk c WHERE c.revision_id = r.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.modality = 'VISUAL') AS has_visual, FALSE AS pinned, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.id ORDER BY FIELD(link.scope_type, 'CONVERSATION', 'DIAGRAM', 'CHARTBOOK', 'LIBRARY'), link.created_at) AS rn FROM material m JOIN material_version v ON v.material_id = m.id AND v.id IN #{id} JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = COALESCE(v.active_revision_id, (SELECT pending.id FROM material_processing_revision pending WHERE pending.version_id = v.id ORDER BY pending.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1)) JOIN material_scope_link link ON link.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN diagram d ON d.id = #{diagramId} AND d.user_id = #{ownerKey} AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE AND ((link.scope_type = 'CONVERSATION' AND link.scope_key = #{conversationId}) OR (link.scope_type = 'DIAGRAM' AND link.scope_key = #{diagramId}) OR (link.scope_type = 'CHARTBOOK' AND link.scope_key = d.chartbook_id) OR (link.scope_type = 'LIBRARY' AND link.scope_key IN ('personal', 'library', #{ownerKey}))) ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1

SELECT u.id AS declaration_id, m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, r.id AS revision_id, COALESCE(m.kind, 'UNKNOWN') AS kind, 'CONVERSATION' AS scope_type, #{conversationId} AS scope_key, COALESCE(r.state, 'PROCESSING') AS state, CASE WHEN u.state = 'CREATED' AND u.policy_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE u.state END AS upload_state, TRUE AS conversation_scoped, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk c WHERE c.revision_id = r.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.modality IN ('TEXT', 'TABLE')) AS has_text, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk c WHERE c.revision_id = r.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.modality = 'VISUAL') AS has_visual, FALSE AS pinned FROM material_upload_session u LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = u.material_id LEFT JOIN material_version v ON v.id = u.version_id AND v.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = u.processing_revision_id AND r.version_id = v.id LEFT JOIN material_scope_link link ON link.material_id = m.id AND link.scope_type = 'CONVERSATION' AND link.scope_key = #{conversationId} WHERE u.id IN #{id} AND u.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND u.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND u.target_scope_type = 'CONVERSATION' AND u.target_scope_key = #{conversationId} AND (m.id IS NULL OR ( AND link.material_id IS NOT NULL))

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT m.id AS material_id, v.id AS version_id, r.id AS revision_id, m.kind, v.id AS declaration_id, '' AS upload_state, 'DIAGRAM' AS scope_type, #{diagramId} AS scope_key, r.state, FALSE AS conversation_scoped, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk c WHERE c.revision_id = r.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.modality IN ('TEXT', 'TABLE')) AS has_text, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk c WHERE c.revision_id = r.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.modality = 'VISUAL') AS has_visual, TRUE AS pinned, 1 AS priority FROM diagram_source_pin pin JOIN material m ON m.id = pin.material_id JOIN material_version v ON v.id = pin.version_id AND v.material_id = m.id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = pin.processing_revision_id WHERE pin.diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND UNION ALL SELECT m.id, v.id, r.id, m.kind, v.id, '', link.scope_type, link.scope_key, r.state, (link.scope_type = 'CONVERSATION'), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk c WHERE c.revision_id = r.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.modality IN ('TEXT', 'TABLE')), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retrieval_chunk c WHERE c.revision_id = r.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.modality = 'VISUAL'), FALSE, CASE link.scope_type WHEN 'CONVERSATION' THEN 2 WHEN 'DIAGRAM' THEN 3 WHEN 'CHARTBOOK' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END FROM material m JOIN material_version v ON v.id = m.latest_version_id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = COALESCE(v.active_revision_id, (SELECT pending.id FROM material_processing_revision pending WHERE pending.version_id = v.id ORDER BY pending.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1)) JOIN material_scope_link link ON link.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN diagram d ON d.id = #{diagramId} AND d.user_id = #{ownerKey} AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE AND ((link.scope_type = 'CONVERSATION' AND link.scope_key = #{conversationId}) OR (link.scope_type = 'DIAGRAM' AND link.scope_key = #{diagramId}) OR (link.scope_type = 'CHARTBOOK' AND link.scope_key = d.chartbook_id) ) ), ranked AS ( SELECT candidates.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY version_id ORDER BY priority) AS rn FROM candidates ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY priority, material_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(pending_upload_ids_json), 0) FROM conversation_source_context WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} LIMIT 1
